name: My CodexBar
tagline: Claude Code and Codex usage limits, resets and spend in your menu bar.
description: My CodexBar shows how much of your Claude Code (and, if you switch them on, Codex and other AI coding) plan is left, right in the menu bar: the 5-hour session and weekly limits, when they reset, and what your local sessions would cost at API prices. It reads everything on your Mac and warns you before a limit runs out. A private copy of CodexBar by Peter Steinberger (MIT), maintained independently.
